entities.name: KRIT1
entities.merge_basis: R8: KRTI1 (b0005) is edit distance 2 from KRIT1, appears in the same three-gene panel list that reads 'KRIT1, CCM2, and PDCD10' in b0003/b0014/b0019, and is not defined elsewhere.
entities.ambiguity: 'KRIT1 protein ankyrin component' (b0100) is a protein-product mention.

entities.name: CCM2
entities.merge_basis: Single surface form; not merged with animal-model Ccm2 (R2).
entities.ambiguity: Shares the 'CCM' prefix with the disease abbreviation; every occurrence denotes the gene or its carrier group.

entities.name: PDCD10
entities.merge_basis: Single surface form; not merged with animal-model Pdcd10 (R2).

entities.name: ZPLD1
entities.species: human (only through human patient context; not explicitly stated)

entities.name: MAP3K3
entities.species: human (only through human patient context; not explicitly stated)
entities.merge_basis: b0098 'MAP3K3, encoding MEKK3': MEKK3 kept as protein-product role of G05, not a separate gene.

entities.name: cerebral cavernous malformation (CCM)
entities.parent_basis: b0011 'Cerebral cavernous malformation (CCM) is an intracranial vascular malformation' (explicit 'X is a Y'); name = 'cerebral' + cavernous malformation (D04).
entities.merge_basis: Abbreviation defined in b0011. R8: CMM (b0099) is edit distance 2 from CCM, used in the same sentence pair about therapeutics ('few therapeutic strategies for CCM … therapeutics for CMM'), and never defined.
entities.ambiguity: 'CCM' also prefixes gene-set terms (CCM genes, CCM complexes, CCM genotype) and lesion terms (CCM lesions); those mentions are role-tagged, not disease mentions.

entities.name: familial cerebral cavernous malformation (FCCM)
entities.parent_basis: b0011 'CCM is broadly divided into sporadic and familial categories.'
entities.merge_basis: Abbreviation defined in b0003 and b0011.
entities.ambiguity: Includes 'clinical FCCM' (no mutation detected) and gene-confirmed FCCM, as the paper does.

entities.name: sporadic cerebral cavernous malformation
entities.parent_basis: b0011 'CCM is broadly divided into sporadic and familial categories.'
entities.merge_basis: Elliptical 'sporadic and familial CCM' (b0099) and 'sporadic … categories' (b0011) resolved within the same phrase (R6).

entities.name: cavernous malformation (CM, any site)
entities.merge_basis: Defined in Table 1/2 notes ('CM, cavernous malformation').

entities.name: spinal cavernous malformation
entities.merge_basis: b0016 'spinal cavernous malformation (CM)'; Table 2 'Non-cerebral CM' values 'Spinal (...)'.

entities.name: cavernous angioma with symptomatic hemorrhage (CASH)
original_names: cavernous angiomas with a symptomatic hemorrhage
cavernous angiomas with the occurrence of symptomatic hemorrhage
entities.merge_basis: Abbreviation defined in b0016/b0021 and table notes; 'recurrent symptomatic hemorrhage' uses the defining phrase.
entities.ambiguity: Named haemorrhagic event of CCM (R1: named clinical event, in primary matrix).

entities.name: intracranial vascular malformation
entities.ambiguity: Class term used to define CCM.

entities.name: tumor (unspecified)
entities.ambiguity: Family term; specific tumours are separate nodes.

entities.name: diffuse midline glioma
entities.merge_basis: Same term in b0070 and Table 2 (K3).

entities.name: PLE (undefined in text)
entities.merge_basis: R8: not expanded anywhere; not merged with OLE.
entities.ambiguity: In diagnosis position for K3 ('FIAS and FBTCS, 51YO → PLE'), parallel to '→ OLE' for K8; R1 keeps it in the primary matrix as ambiguous.

auxiliary_entities.name: cerebral microbleeds
